mentions.name: Taskade Genesis
mentions.description: Taskade Genesis is an AI workspace that turns a single prompt into a living system—CRM, ops hub, internal tool, or business in a box—where memory, agents, and automations work together. It treats the workspace itself as the layer where AI-generated apps live, remember state, coordinate agents, trigger workflows, and keep operating day to day, positioned as closer to early web hosting than modern SaaS.
mentions.problem: LLMs made it easy to generate apps, but the harder problem is running them as real businesses—where they live, remember state, coordinate agents, trigger workflows, and keep operating day to day.
mentions.audience: Builders running AI-generated apps as real businesses, shipping internal apps and workflows rather than demos
mentions.source_excerpt:
Connecting the dots from agents to workflow automation to infrastructure with Taskade Genesis.

LLMs made it easy to generate apps. The harder problem is running them as real businesses. Where they live, remember state, coordinate agents, trigger workflows, and keep operating day to day. We treat the workspace itself as that layer.

One prompt becomes a living system. CRM, ops hub, internal tool, business in a box. Memory, agents, and automations working together.

mentions.name: Taskade
mentions.description: Collaborative workspace platform where humans and AI work side by side, built around three pillars: Projects, Agents, and Automation. Teams can organize projects in real time, generate structured task lists, mind maps, and tables, train custom AI agents with dynamic knowledge, and automate work from start to finish.
